table_description: One row per prison that has ever been switched on for managing property in DPS rather than NOMIS. table_description: A sealed container of one prisoner's property. The record is event-sourced: its history lives in property_event and its current status and location are derived from the most recent relevant event. Five values are mirrored into columns here (seal number, status, internal location, storage location type, receiving prison) so the establishment-wide list can filter and page in SQL; the derivation stays authoritative and every write refreshes the mirrors.
column_description: Primary key. Time-ordered UUID v7, so insert order matches id order.
